brief.claim: In adult mice, liver weight is positively related to kidney weight after accounting for body mass: the coefficient of kidney weight in a linear regression of liver weight on kidney weight and body mass is at least 0.25 (g of liver weight per g of kidney weight).

data_keys.meaning: Wet liver weight of each mouse, in g.
Combined wet weight of both kidneys of each mouse, in g.
Body mass of each mouse, in g.

brief.sizes: mice = 150; liver_weight, kidney_weight and body_mass each have shape (150,).
